subject: Mutual action plan: TideBridge SDK routing, backoff & quota safeguards
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@tidebridge.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps after demo - mutual action plan

Hey Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. TideBridge is excited to move to a short pilot and we want to lock down a mutual action plan so we can get our engineers into a sandbox next week.

Initial asks from our side:
- Sandbox API keys and sample webhooks
- SDK quickstart for Node and Go
- Expected rate limits and per-token cost guidance
- Recommended backoff and retry patterns for bursty traffic

Happy to jump on a 30 minute call to go through the MAP. Priya Shah will be our technical lead on this engagement. Can you share a draft plan and any sample code?

Cheers,
Alex
TideBridge, Director of Integrations
[attachment: TideBridge_context_packet.pdf]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@tidebridge.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo - mutual action plan

Alex,

Great to connect. Putting a short mutual action plan together and attaching the working MAP and a sample config. High level timeline:
- Nov 2: sandbox keys + sample config delivered
- Nov 3-9: dev sandbox integration and initial traffic tests
- Nov 10: pilot go/no-go

Quick notes on the technical asks:
- SDKs: Node and Go quickstarts included in tidebridge-sample-config.yaml
- Rate limits: default sandbox quota 30 rps with 1200 token/sec aggregate; we can increase for the pilot
- Backoff: recommend jittered exponential backoff with max 10s and 6 retries for idempotent calls
- Endpoint migration: use x-api-version header and the provided migration guide link

Attached: TideBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx and tidebridge-sample-config.yaml

Next step: Alex and Priya, can you confirm sandbox access window and a time for Friday for a short walkthrough? Monica will own dev onboarding and Vivek will cover traffic shaping and quotas.

Thanks,
Aditya
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
[attachment: TideBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@tidebridge.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@tidebridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo - mutual action plan

Thanks Aditya

That timeline works. A couple of clarifying questions for the sandbox phase:
1) Do you provide separate sandbox and prod endpoints or just a version header per request
2) How do you recommend handling retries for streaming responses vs unary generate calls
3) Can you confirm whether KV cache is preserved across sessions in the sandbox

We are planning to run a burst test of ~1k rps for 60 seconds on Nov 5 as part of our telemetry validation. Will that exceed sandbox limits?

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Platform Engineer, TideBridge

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@tidebridge.com>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo - mutual action plan

Priya,

Quick traffic shaping notes for your engineers and SREs:

- Throttles and quotas: We recommend shaping at the client edge first: token-bucket limiter with burst size equal to 3x steady rps. On the server side we honor per-key quotas and will return 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.
- Progressive ramp: For the pilot, ramp from 10% to 100% traffic across 4 steps, holding each step for 10 minutes to validate latency and error rates.
- Observability: add per-request tags x-tb-session and x-tb-deployment to correlate traces. Send samples to our ingestion endpoint and we will surface token breakdowns per route.

Sample nginx rate limit config snippet in tidebridge-sample-config.yaml:
- limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=redwood:10m rate=30r/s;
- limit_req zone=redwood burst=90 nodelay;

If you need the 1k rps test on Nov 5, confirm a 20 minute window starting at 08:00 PST and I will pre-warm capacity and set a soft quota for the sandbox key.

Thanks,
Vivek
Solutions Architect, Redwood

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@tidebridge.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@tidebridge.com>, monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo - mutual action plan

Team,

All clear, thanks for the detail. We accept the MAP and sandbox provisioning request. Confirming the Nov 5 08:00 PST burst window and that we will receive a temporary sandbox burst key by EOD Nov 3.

Action items I have recorded:
- Redwood: provide sandbox key and burst quota by 2026-11-03 17:00 PST
- Redwood: share final MAP with timeboxed owners and add HubSpot link
- TideBridge: run smoke integration by Nov 4 and burst test on Nov 5 08:00 PST

One more ask for the sample code: can you include a brief example of handling 429 with Retry-After header and a client-side token-bucket pseudo code? If you can drop that in the MAP it will save our SREs time.

Thanks,
Alex
